entities.name: PMID:27513357
observations: Carbon monoxide improves efficacy of mesenchymal stromal cells during sepsis by production of specialized proresolving lipid mediators. Crit Care Med. 2016; DOI:10.1097/CCM.0000000000001999.

entities.name: CO-MSC SPM sepsis finding
observations: In murine cecal ligation and puncture, ex-vivo CO-preconditioned MSCs improved survival, organ injury, bacterial clearance, and inflammatory resolution; with DHA they produced SPMs, particularly D-series resolvins.
Silencing 5-lipoxygenase and 12/15-lipoxygenase pathways removed the CO-associated therapeutic benefit, supporting a contribution of SPM biosynthesis; preclinical animal/cell study.

entities.name: Carbon monoxide
observations: Ex-vivo preconditioning agent for MSCs in the PMID:27513357 murine sepsis study.

entities.name: Mesenchymal stromal cells
observations: CO-preconditioned MSCs showed enhanced therapeutic activity in murine polymicrobial sepsis in PMID:27513357.

entities.name: D-series resolvins
observations: Among SPMs produced by CO-exposed MSCs with DHA substrate; implicated in improved survival in the murine sepsis study PMID:27513357.

entities.name: Polymicrobial sepsis
